steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: make-same-size-different-style-doors
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const doors = (s.floorPlan.openings || []).filter(o => o.kind === 'door'); if (doors.length < 2) throw new Error('need >=2 ground doors, got ' + doors.length); const W = 0.9; s.updateOpening(doors[0].id, { width: W, style: 'sliding', material: 'wood' }); s.updateOpening(doors[1].id, { width: W, style: 'panel', material: 'painted' }); window.__doorIds = [doors[0].id, doors[1].id]; })()

steps.name: intercept-window-open
steps.eval: window.open = () => ({ document: { write(h) { window.__capturedHtml = h }, close() {} }, close() {}, focus() {}, print() {} })

steps.name: assert-style-column-and-split
steps.eval: (() => { const html = window.__capturedHtml; const need = (re, label) => { if (!re.test(html)) throw new Error('missing: ' + label) }; need(/Style \/ material/, 'Style / material column header'); need(/Sliding · Wood/, 'sliding+wood door style cell'); need(/Panel · Painted/, 'panel+painted door style cell'); need(/>D1</, 'D1 mark'); need(/>D2</, 'D2 mark (same-size split)'); window.__stylesOk = true; })()

steps.name: scroll-to-opening-schedule-sheet
steps.eval: (() => { const names = [...document.querySelectorAll('.tb-name')]; const nameEl = names.find((el) => el.textContent.trim() === 'Door & window schedule'); const target = nameEl && nameEl.closest('.sheet'); if (!target) throw new Error('opening schedule sheet not found in rendered document'); target.scrollIntoView(); })()
